statement: /etc/ -- just /etc with a trailing / added -- must not be admitted either (sem: SEM-gx-gate-332)
why: of the two spellings of the same place, a pack that has only the `==` side misses this one (`"/etc/" == "/etc"` is false). What protects it is the glob side, which depends on the primary reading that `*` matches even zero characters -- if that reading changed, this vector would tip onto the admit side. (sem: SEM-gx-gate-333)
